intent: Design an agentic system framed as a startup company structure — flat, low-bureaucracy — where a founder orchestrator delegates work to IC agents and synthesizes results back into a coherent deliverable that respects user intent.
tldr: Full IC roster (builder, researcher, designer, marketer, critic) and founder-side skill table landed in commit 946c8c7; topology is now structurally complete and ready for end-to-end dry-run.
mental_model: IC template as a contract: every IC shares the same shape — frontmatter, responsibilities, JSON in/out, operating rules, skill table, anti-patterns, escalation, blackboard rules — so the founder can route without reading each file in full.
Skill tables as procedural overrides: each agent maps domain triggers to addy-agent-skills, turning improvised reasoning into named playbooks that can be audited via skills_invoked.
Blackboard write asymmetry: only founder writes Decisions and Spec; only Marketer writes Positioning; all other ICs are read-only and return through founder synthesis.
Severity ladder as the ship gate: Critic returns verdict + severity-tagged findings (blocker/major/minor/nit) instead of fixing — preserves founder's authority over remediation.
Verification ladder as cheapest-signal-first: Builder climbs typecheck → lint → targeted test → smoke run and stops at first real signal, avoiding full-suite cost on small changes.

state_delta.text: Full IC roster landed (builder, researcher, designer, marketer, critic) in commit 946c8c7 following the same template.
Every IC + founder wired to addy-agent-skills via a Skill references table; return JSON gains skills_invoked field for audit.
Marketer is the only IC permitted to append to the blackboard (## Positioning section).
Builder verification ladder fixed: typecheck → lint → targeted test → smoke run; stop at first real signal.
Critic is a one-pass ship gate with severity-tagged findings (blocker|major|minor|nit) and verdict go|no-go|conditional; never writes fixes.
Added .claude/agents/{builder,researcher,designer,marketer,critic}.md and extended .claude/agents/founder.md with its own skill table.
Sibling subagents drafting designer, marketer, critic in parallel produced consistent output by being briefed to follow builder.md and researcher.md as templates.
Skill tables on each agent may drift across agents over time; no enforced lint to keep them aligned with the addy-agent-skills marketplace.
Topology has not yet been exercised end-to-end against a sample intent; loop semantics (parallel fan-out, conflict resolution, stage-report cadence) are unverified.
blackboard.md is a single-writer file; concurrent IC appends (only Marketer for now) could clobber if future ICs gain write access.
